def mod_pow(base, exp):
    mod = 1000000007
    return pow(base, exp, mod)

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    power = 1
    if k == 0:
        power = p - 1
    elif k == 1:
        power = p
    else:
        x = k
        while x != 1:
            x = (x * k) % p
            power += 1
        power = (p - 1) // power
    print(mod_pow(p, power))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
